# Search api

Your real-time SERP API solution. Mastering proxy management, CAPTCHAs, and JSON parsing for seamless web data extraction.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/search-api/.

## Actions

- **Get Account Info** (read-only): Retrieve account usage statistics including monthly usage, remaining credits, hourly limits, and subscription period information.
- **Get Locations** (read-only): Get available locations for geo-localized search queries.
- **Search** (read-only): Perform unified search across 40+ search engines including Google, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo, YouTube, Amazon, and more.
- **Get Cached Search by ID** (read-only): Retrieve cached search results by search ID in JSON format.
- **Get Cached Search HTML by ID** (read-only): Retrieve cached search results by search ID in HTML format.
